verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a search-results API, and offering AI-generated insights on a user's data is a plausible feature for such a service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such capability inside the product. The AI-related items are all adjacent: LLM-optimized markdown output, an MCP server for external agents, RAG positioning, and scraping Google's AI Mode answers. None of these has SerpApi itself generating insights or suggestions from the user's data, so they earn no credit.
